connector.name: Coordinalo - Service Business Operations
connector.registryDescription: Scheduling, availability, clients, billing and CRM for appointment-based services.
connector.summary: Hosted at coordinalo.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.coordinalo, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-Org-Api-Key
headers.description: Organization API key (sk_admin_...). Required for org-scoped tools. Omit it to use the public booking lane.

headers.name: X-Bootstrap-Key
headers.description: Bootstrap key for admin_create_organization only. Self-service at https://coordinalo.com/developers
